objective: separate full-prefix and gated-response effects under identical CaseVO orchestration

existing_response_evidence.required_gate: minimum 4 uncensored first responses and aligned/inverse posterior at least 0.95
existing_response_evidence.legacy_independent_expectation: gated estimator remains exactly fixed-P9 on all six legacy cases

arms.plan_only: one initial depth12-width4 mean-audited full-prefix proposal; original P9 after rejection/completion
arms.response_only: no plan search; P9 unchanged before response gate, gated-estimator public-greedy candidates after activation
arms.combined: the same initial plan proposal plus the same gated response switch after activation

llm_protocol.ranker: same deterministic mock ranker for every arm and seed
llm_protocol.p10_plan_choice: explicitly approve the P10 plan candidate when exposed
llm_protocol.invalid_output: must use the original P9 deterministic fallback and may never start P10

candidate_semantics: P10 augments rather than replaces the candidates produced by super P9
when P8 and P10 are both exposed, report public-greedy reference zero and each continuation gain on that basis
LLM selection of any original P9 candidate rejects the P10 prefix
response gate activation pauses old-prior P8 rollout and uses only the gated estimator's public-greedy candidate set
plan search occurs once immediately after full scan and is never delayed to collect response probes
error_policy: predict, gate, or observe exceptions permanently disable the new estimator for that episode
successful public action facts remain recorded before estimator fallback
prefix action failure clears the remaining prefix and returns to P9 with actual remaining budget
required_results: all 24 runtime arm/case results complete under one worker
paired score and win/tie/loss for plan_only, response_only, and combined versus P9
plan approval/completion, response gate activation and estimator disable counters
action count, remaining budget, failure count and compact action hash
raw action/payload logs remain ignored and compact audit is committed
decision: development only; no new confirmation is opened
do not combine gains from different seeds arithmetically
advance at most one runtime arm after the main agent freezes a separate confirmation protocol
no production, qualification, config, build, or official-score claim

terminal_comparison_amendment.excluded_checkpoint: the interrupted first four-family run used a mock ranker that always selected P10 and is not part of results
terminal_comparison_amendment.display_basis: PG reference, P8 proposal and P10 proposal use equal-resource terminal continuation gain; their displayed ROI is gain divided by current total budget
terminal_comparison_amendment.ordinary_candidates: retain the complete original P9 candidate map internally for invalid/unavailable deterministic fallback; expose only its PG reference in the terminal-gain LLM comparison so immediate scores cannot suppress complete plans
terminal_comparison_amendment.mock_ranker: select maximum terminal continuation gain among P10, P8 and PG-reference alternatives; never force P10 by identity
terminal_comparison_amendment.combined_initial_invariant: the response gate is closed at the initial full scan, so combined supplies no response override to root plan search and must propose the same plan as plan_only
